display_title: 21-4-3 《地球仪制作者：一门古老工艺的奇妙故事》

sentences.en: A review of Peter Bellerby's book The Globemakers
sentences.zh: 评彼得·贝勒比的《地球仪制作者》。

sentences.en: In 2008, Peter Bellerby, who lived in London, wanted to give his father a model globe for his eightieth birthday.
sentences.zh: 2008年，住在伦敦的彼得·贝勒比想送父亲一只地球仪，作为他的八十岁生日礼物。

sentences.en: What seemed simple enough to start with triggered an almost obsessive, decade-long journey, marked by a series of obstacles that would have deterred anyone less determined.
sentences.zh: 这件起初看似简单的事，让他踏上了一段长达十年、近乎痴迷的历程。一路上障碍接踵而至，换了意志稍不坚定的人，早就被吓退了。

sentences.en: It ended with his establishing the world's only bespoke globemaking company.
sentences.zh: 最终，他创办了世界上唯一一家专做定制地球仪的公司。

sentences.en: The first surprise in The Globemakers, Bellerby's account of this impulsive enterprise, is that obtaining such a globe was not simply a matter of a quick online order and a repressed sigh at the shipping costs.
sentences.zh: 在《地球仪制作者》中，贝勒比记述了自己这一时兴起的事业。书中第一个出人意料的地方是，想弄到这样一只地球仪，远不只是上网下个单、看着运费忍住一声叹息那么简单。

sentences.en: After all, contrary to stubbornly held popular views of our ancestors' geographical ignorance, we have known that the world is spherical since at least the 6th century BCE.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，很多人一直固执地以为祖先缺乏地理知识；而事实上，至少从公元前6世纪起，人类就知道地球是球形的。

sentences.en: The ancient Greek philosopher Plato in his work Phaedo likened it to a leather ball, while the accolade of producing the first recorded globe goes to the ancient Greek philosopher Crates of Mallus, who is said to have made one in around 150 BCE.
sentences.zh: 古希腊哲学家柏拉图在《斐多篇》里把地球比作皮球。至于制作了史上第一只有记载的地球仪，这一荣誉属于古希腊哲学家马洛斯的克拉特斯，据说他在约公元前150年做出了一只。

sentences.en: Surely, Bellerby reasoned, a good-quality globe wouldn't be difficult to find.
sentences.zh: 贝勒比心想，找一只质量好的地球仪，总不至于太难吧。

sentences.en: Nearly two millennia later, however, it seemed that the art of globemaking had been largely forgotten.
sentences.zh: 然而，近两千年过去，制作地球仪的技艺似乎已被人们忘得差不多了。

sentences.en: Bellerby came across shoddy commercial versions designed for school classrooms and genuine antiques in auction houses that would have bust his budget.
sentences.zh: 贝勒比找到的，要么是为学校课堂生产的粗制滥造的商品，要么是拍卖行里的真古董，而后者的价格又远超他的预算。

sentences.en: Even his trips to Morocco and India, where surely the knowledge of artisan cartographers* had been preserved, drew a blank.
sentences.zh: 他甚至去了摩洛哥和印度，心想这些地方总该保留着手工制图师的技艺，结果还是一无所获。

sentences.en: Not one to be easily thwarted, Bellerby decided to make his own good-quality globe.
sentences.zh: 贝勒比不是个轻易受挫就退缩的人。他决定亲手做一只优质地球仪。

sentences.en: In the process, almost everything that could possibly go wrong did so.
sentences.zh: 在制作过程中，几乎所有可能出岔子的地方都真的出了岔子。

sentences.en: Even the shape of the Earth posed a problem, as it is not quite a perfect sphere, but oblate (slightly flattened at the poles).
sentences.zh: 连地球的形状都成了难题。它并不是个完美的正球体，而是扁球体，也就是两极略微扁平。

sentences.en: Having decided to compromise and opt for two half-spherical pieces that could be fitted together, he was unable to discover anyone capable of casting moulds with sufficient accuracy to ensure that he would not be left with two half-spheres that were not quite the same circumference.
sentences.zh: 他决定退而求其次，用两个能拼合的半球来做。可是，他找不到能把模具铸得足够精确的人，好让做出来的两个半球周长完全一样，不会有一点儿对不上的地方。

sentences.en: Even after he eventually resolved this issue, extracting these from the moulds resulted in piles of cracked plaster of Paris** and clouds of choking dust in the workshop he had set up at the rear of his house.
sentences.zh: 即便最终解决了这个问题，等到从模具里取出半球时，他设在屋后的工坊里还是堆满了碎裂的熟石膏，呛人的粉尘四处弥漫。

sentences.en: This series of abortive experiments taught Bellerby a lot about the challenges of making globes, which he communicates here to the reader.
sentences.zh: 这一连串失败的试验让贝勒比对地球仪制作的难处有了深切体会，他在书里把这些体会告诉了读者。

sentences.en: Finding just the right way to prise the globes from the mould – a high-end air compressor finally did the trick – and locating the right paper and inks with which to make the gores (the sections of flat sheet mapping that are pasted onto the spherical globe) without the ink seeping out to create a mushy, unreadable mess took months and an alarming chunk out of his bank balance.
sentences.zh: 他得找到把球体从模具中撬出的恰当方法，最终是一台高档空气压缩机解决了问题。他还得找到合适的纸和油墨来制作球瓣图，也就是贴在球体表面的瓜瓣形平面地图。油墨绝不能洇开，把图案糊成无法辨认的一团。这些摸索耗去了好几个月，也花掉了他一大笔令人心惊的存款。

sentences.en: Bellerby's frustration at the painstaking process of attaching the gores to the globe surface – after having found a glue with precisely the right adhesive qualities – is palpable.
sentences.zh: 好不容易找到黏性恰到好处的胶，贝勒比又得费尽心力，一片片把球瓣图贴到球面上。那股挫败感，读者几乎也能感受到。

sentences.en: Right at the end of the process, he learnt that the paper had stretched slightly and so the final one overlapped the first by a centimetre (which may not seem a great deal, but when that represents 2 per cent of the Earth's diameter, it's equivalent to obliterating the Himalayas or wiping out Chile).
sentences.zh: 到最后他才发现，纸张略有拉伸，导致最后一片贴图和第一片重叠了一厘米。这看起来或许没多少，但如果它代表地球直径的2%，那就相当于把喜马拉雅山脉抹去，或者让智利从地图上消失。

sentences.en: Bellerby's account of the technical challenges of globe production is interspersed with a series of interludes on great globemakers of the past and cartographic history in general.
sentences.zh: 贝勒比一边记述制作地球仪的技术难题，一边穿插讲述历代制球名家，以及更广泛的地图制图史上的一些故事。

sentences.en: Purists might wish for more map-making details, but Bellerby clearly found a kindred spirit in Martin Behaim.
sentences.zh: 讲究制图技术的行家或许想看到更多细节，不过贝勒比显然在马丁·贝海姆身上看到了同道中人的影子。

sentences.en: He was the Nuremberg entrepreneur who in 1492 created the Erdapfel, the world's oldest surviving globe, beautifully finished by a workshop of painters and other craftsmen, only to find that the explorer Christopher Columbus had stumbled upon the Americas the very same year, rendering his masterpiece instantly out of date.
sentences.zh: 贝海姆是纽伦堡的一位企业家，1492年制作了世界上现存最古老的地球仪“地球苹果”，由一个汇集画家和其他工匠的作坊精心完成最后的装饰。谁料，探险家克里斯托弗·哥伦布恰在同一年偶然抵达美洲，这件杰作一下子就过时了。

sentences.en: Something of Bellerby's unflinching ambition is reflected in the even more heroic efforts of the Italian cartographer Vincenzo Coronelli, who, in the seventeenth century, created two globes for Louis XIV of France.
sentences.zh: 贝勒比不屈不挠的雄心，在意大利制图师文琴佐·科罗内利更为艰巨的努力中也可见一斑。17世纪，科罗内利曾为法国国王路易十四制作两只球仪。

sentences.en: It took him twenty years to complete the monstrous pair, whose vast bulk – each with a diameter of around four metres – can still be admired in the National Library of France in Paris.
sentences.zh: 他花了二十年才完成这对庞然大物，每一只的直径都在四米左右。时至今日，人们仍能在巴黎的法国国家图书馆欣赏到这两只球仪的雄姿。

sentences.en: Although a celebration of the revival of an ancient craft, Bellerby's book is also a lament for the fading away of centuries-old traditions.
sentences.zh: 贝勒比的书既礼赞一门古老工艺的复兴，也哀叹相传数百年的传统正逐渐消逝。

sentences.en: When he embarked on his globemaking odyssey, he struggled to find artisans with the skills to make the right moulds for the globes or foundries that could shape the meridians (the metal frames which girdle globes) in just the right way.
sentences.zh: 刚踏上制作地球仪的漫长旅程时，他苦于找不到能制作合适球模的工匠，也找不到能把子午圈准确加工成形的铸造厂。子午圈就是环抱球体的金属框架。

sentences.en: Although he finally located the right craftsmen, some simply dropping in, serendipitously, to his workshop (by now in more suitable premises than his back room), many of these have now retired or passed away.
sentences.zh: 他最终还是找到了合适的工匠，有些人甚至是碰巧来工坊拜访的。那时他已搬进了比屋后房间更合适的场地。不过，这些工匠许多如今已退休或离世。

sentences.en: Bellerby's father finally did receive his eightieth birthday present, albeit two years late.
sentences.zh: 贝勒比的父亲最终确实收到了自己的八十岁生日礼物，尽管迟到了两年。

sentences.en: Bellerby went on to found a company which now turns out over six hundred globes a year for customers who can have their own tiny village marked or more unusual requests fulfilled.
sentences.zh: 贝勒比后来创办了一家公司，如今每年制作六百多个地球仪。客户可以请他们在球上标出自己生活的小村庄，也可以提出更加特别的定制要求。

sentences.en: His book, beautifully illustrated with photographs of the various stages of his venture and a few illustrations of historic globes and maps, is hardly a blueprint for commercial success.
sentences.zh: 书中配了许多精美插图，包括记录他创业各个阶段的照片，以及几幅历史地球仪和地图的图像。不过，这本书很难算得上一本商业成功指南。

sentences.en: But it is more than enough to stir up admiration for the craftsmanship of the great mapmakers of the past and the obsessive determination of a modern successor who revived their almost moribund art.
sentences.zh: 但它足以让人由衷钦佩古代地图制作者的高超技艺，也钦佩这位当代传人近乎痴迷的决心——正是他让这门濒临消亡的手艺重获生机。
